open_points.subject: startup manifest validation
open_points.text: a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it
open_points.question: With no operation or binding named and the store not yet open, which A08 rule 5 checks and which capability entries must `bindings.check_installed_instances` validate?
options: Validate only the record envelope, capability-name uniqueness and selected-instance headers needed for the credential-header collision check
Validate every capability entry as though each operation were being proposed
Validate only operations referenced by accepted bindings
open_points.default_guess: Validate the record envelope, capability-name uniqueness and the selected instance facts needed for the startup header-collision check.

open_points.subject: draft-write send authority
open_points.text: a `draft-write` node needs nothing at run time — its authority is the version's FlowActivation ... The effect sent once, on the exact request the owner was shown or under the owner's grant
open_points.question: Does the reviewed flow permit an ordinary `draft-write` send under its FlowActivation, or must every successful effect satisfy the outcome's approval-or-grant description?
options: Permit `draft-write` under the pinned FlowActivation, except a resend after `not_applied`
Require an approval or grant for every `draft-write` send
open_points.default_guess: Permit the ordinary `draft-write` send under the pinned FlowActivation.

open_points.subject: startup run recovery ordering
open_points.text: then derives every run that has not ended ... rewriting a lagging status or waiting point and reaching again ... an operation element whose wait no longer holds ... then, as the kernel actor, advances every run left `running`
open_points.question: Must recovery first derive all non-ended runs without executing or sending anything and only then advance them, or may it reach and send an operation while deriving each run?
options: Derive every run first, then advance the runs left `running` in oldest-first order
For each run in oldest-first order, derive it and immediately reach any newly unblocked operation before processing the next run
open_points.default_guess: Derive all runs first, then advance those left `running` in oldest-first order.

open_points.subject: randomly minted record identities
open_points.question: What module or capability supplies and owns the randomness and collision retry used to mint `trial_execution_id`, `binding_id`, `run_id`, `approval_id` and `grant_id`?
options: Each record-owning module reads the operating system CSPRNG and retries collisions through the store
A shared lower-level randomness capability supplies all minted identifiers
The store mints every random identifier inside the writing transaction
open_points.default_guess: Each record-owning module uses the operating system CSPRNG and retries a store collision.
